text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.
reply_text:
Sofia, it was Pellow. In #coastal-team on 17 Feb, Kwame said your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup. You agreed. That account is Pellow Home Living, which was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. The Gulf Coast terminal and container rows are Pellucid Harbor Logistics.

Both show up under "PHL" in the morning report, which is probably why it got muddled.
